The '''Kardura system''' was located in the [[Juvex sector/Legends|Juvex sector]], a part of the [[Senex-Juvex/Legends|Senex-Juvex]] region in the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. The [[Kassido Bypass]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] linked it to the [[Dioll system/Legends|Dioll]] and [[Yhifar system/Legends|Yhifar systems]]. The [[Star system/Legends|system]] was [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] to the [[Karduran]]s, a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that were subservient to [[House Kassido]], a [[Noble/Legends|noble]] [[Ancient Houses|house]] based on the nearby [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Kassido]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Kardura system was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square L-17.<ref name="TEA" />
